run_f_gold: run f_gold to count minimum subsets of consecutive numbers from an array
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple input arrays to verify correct subset counting
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to handle edge cases like empty arrays or single elements
review_f_gold: review f_gold algorithm that sorts input and counts breaks in consecutive sequences
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which partitions an array into minimum subsets of consecutive numbers
